name: VITA Free Tax Help
description: Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA): free tax return preparation by volunteers at Community Action Pioneer Valley's tax clinics, which run January-April. Offices include 155 Pleasant Street, Northampton and 393 Main Street, Greenfield. Help is by appointment only; appointment information for the 2027 tax season had not been posted when this was checked.
contact: 413-376-1136 (general program and scheduling questions); dzyra@communityaction.us; 155 Pleasant Street, Northampton, MA 01060; 393 Main Street, Greenfield, MA 01301

requirements.text: You must live in Hampshire County, Franklin County, or the North Quabbin towns of Athol, Petersham, Royalston and Phillipston.
Your income must be at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level: one person $31,920; two $43,280; three $54,640; four $66,000; five $77,360. (The page does not say which year these limits are for.)

They can't help if your return includes rental income, sale of stocks or investment property, capital gains or losses, royalties, certain business expenses, cancellation of debt, military income, out-of-state income, or if you are a foreign student with an F, J, M or Q visa.
By appointment only. Appointment information for the 2027 VITA tax season will be updated in late 2026; check back in January 2027.
